title: its-checks saved project intent
description: Source identity, selected integrations/automation, and input answers for one target package. This records intent, not installation success or a pin for future runs. Repository: https://github.com/ItsEthanDev/its-checks

$schema.description: Editor schema URL. Runtime decoding is offline; this URL is independent of the generating commit.

source.description: Source repository configured by the generating policy. Credentials, query strings, and fragments are rejected by the installer.

commit.description: Full commit of the executing generator when reliably known. Omitted for dirty checkouts or unknown revisions, never inferred from remote HEAD or the schema URL. This does not pin future runs.

integrations.description: Integration directory IDs to preselect in the next dialogue.

automation.description: Automation directory IDs to preselect in the next dialogue.

additionalProperties.description: Answers keyed by input ID. Current declarations validate types and target-relative paths.

answers.description: Input answers namespaced by bundle, used for dialogue prefill. Fresh output contains only currently selected, declared inputs.

id.description: Stable lowercase directory or input ID, optionally separated by hyphens.
